app_fee.value: Tulane does not charge application fees for School of Science & Engineering or Biomedical graduate PhD programs.
app_fee.quote: there are no application fees for our PhD, MS, or Graduate Certificate programs

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is required.
fee_waiver.quote: there are no application fees for our PhD, MS, or Graduate Certificate programs

gre_general.value: The School of Science and Engineering does not require GRE scores for review; requirements vary by department.
gre_general.quote: The School of Science and Engineering does not require GRE scores for review by the department. Applicants who have taken the GRE may include their scores on the application.

toefl_min.value: Minimum overall score on TOEFL iBT is 87 for Science & Engineering graduate programs.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum overall score on TOEFL iBT: 87.

ielts_min.value: Minimum overall band score on IELTS Academic is 7.0 for Science & Engineering graduate programs.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum overall band score on IELTS Academic: 7.0.

english_waiver.value: English test is waived only for degrees from the US or countries where English is the primary spoken language of daily life; India is not exempt.
english_waiver.quote: A bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited university located in the U.S or another country in which English is both the primary spoken language of daily life and the language of instruction

notes: Graduate school (OGPS) sets no university-wide fee, GRE or English minimum. The School of Science and Engineering, School of Medicine (Biomedical Sciences) and School of Public Health each set their own rules, recorded as overrides in their program records.
